text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm on my way to the shopping district
when I
encounter Haru Urara singing a
tune.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The people from the shopping district
got me a
"you can do it" present! Isn't
that sweet?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Last time it was a "don't overdo it" gift,
but now
it's "you can do it"!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I bet it's because I've got a lot more
"oomph" in
my running these days!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And you're part of the reason why,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Three cheers for us! Hip, hip,
hooray!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I promise Haru Urara that we'll both give
it our
best shot.
